<td class="text"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>Note 4.&#160;<span style="text-decoration:underline">Income Taxes</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of June 30, 2026, the Company has $3,000 in
gross deferred tax assets resulting from net operating loss of $16,009, available to offset future taxable income through 2041 subject
to the change in ownership provisions under IRC 382. A valuation allowance has been recorded to fully offset these deferred tax assets
because the Company&#8217;s management believes future realization of the related tax benefits is uncertain.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The tax provision at the statutory federal income
tax rate on June 30, 2026, and the tax provisions attributable to loss before income taxes are as follows:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>
